# Vendored viewer dependencies

Committed rather than fetched at runtime. The first three are unmodified `dist`
builds; the last two are the backdrop.

| File | Version | Licence |
|------|---------|---------|
| [`maplibre-gl.js`](maplibre-gl.js) | 4.7.1 | 3-Clause BSD |
| [`maplibre-gl.css`](maplibre-gl.css) | 4.7.1 | 3-Clause BSD |
| [`pmtiles.js`](pmtiles.js) | 4.4.1 | 3-Clause BSD |
| [`basemap-style.js`](basemap-style.js) | 5.7.2 | 3-Clause BSD |
| [`fonts`](fonts) | 2025.10.31 | SIL Open Font Licence 1.1 |

The page is normally served on a private network. Loading these from `unpkg.com`
made a public CDN a hard runtime dependency of a deployment that otherwise has
none, and the one component that could take the map down while every byte it
actually renders was already on local disk. There was no Subresource Integrity
attribute either, so the page executed whatever that host returned.

The basemap is held to the same rule, and it is the half that took longest to get
there. It was raster tiles fetched per view from a public tile server, which made
panning the map visible to a third party and the backdrop contingent on that
party's terms — in August 2026 those changed, and every keyless tile came back
with `API KEY REQUIRED` painted diagonally across it. What replaced it is a
vector archive served beside the region archives and drawn with the two files
below — [`../README.md`](../README.md) says what is in it and who builds it.

`basemap-style.js` is 55 MapLibre layers and the colours of both flavours,
generated by [`scripts/basemap_style.py`](../../scripts/basemap_style.py) from
`@protomaps/basemaps`. It is not an unmodified copy: the layers drawing
buildings, points of interest and land use go, because the archive does not carry
those, and the three wanting a sprite sheet are dropped or stripped of their
icons, because a sprite would be one more third-party asset to host. That
script's docstring has the whole of it.

`fonts` is glyph ranges for the three Noto stacks the style asks for, from
[protomaps/basemaps-assets](https://github.com/protomaps/basemaps-assets). Seven
of the 256 ranges each rather than all of them: 2.1 MB against 11.7 MB, covering
Latin, its extended blocks, the combining diacriticals, Greek, Cyrillic and
general punctuation. A label outside those renders blank rather than failing,
which is the trade — the labels on this map are British and Irish place names,
and the missing ranges are scripts none of them are written in.

Glyphs are not optional. MapLibre resolves every `text-field` through the
`glyphs` template, and a style with symbol layers and no glyph endpoint draws the
map correctly with nothing named on it: no error, no warning, and a country of
unlabelled roads.

`wayfare serve` sends everything in this directory as `immutable` for a year, which is the one place it caches outright rather than revalidating. What makes that safe is the query on the URL: both pages ask for `vendor/maplibre-gl.js?v=4.7.1` and not for the bare name, so the request a browser makes changes when the bytes behind it do. Drop the query and a returning visitor holds the old library until the year is out, with nothing on screen to say so. The glyph template in [`util.js`](../util.js) carries the same query for the same reason, and it is the one URL here that is not written in a page.

## Updating

Fetch the package at the new version, update the table above, and update the `?v=` on the `vendor/` URLs in [`index.html`](../index.html), [`art.html`](../art.html) and [`util.js`](../util.js) to match. `tests/test_viewer.py` reads the table above and fails on either half of that being forgotten.

```sh
V=4.7.1  # maplibre-gl
curl -sLo maplibre-gl.js  "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@$V/dist/maplibre-gl.js"
curl -sLo maplibre-gl.css "https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@$V/dist/maplibre-gl.css"

P=4.4.1  # pmtiles
curl -sLo pmtiles.js "https://unpkg.com/pmtiles@$P/dist/pmtiles.js"

# The style is generated rather than copied, and needs a network.
python ../../scripts/basemap_style.py --version 5.7.2
```

The glyphs move on their own schedule and rarely. Their version is the date of
the upstream commit they were taken from, because that repository publishes no
releases. To refresh them, take the same seven ranges of each stack the style
asks for:

```sh
REV=main
for stack in "Noto Sans Regular" "Noto Sans Medium" "Noto Sans Italic"; do
  for range in 0-255 256-511 512-767 768-1023 1024-1279 7680-7935 8192-8447; do
    curl -sLo "fonts/$stack/$range.pbf" --create-dirs \
      "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/protomaps/basemaps-assets/$REV/fonts/${stack// /%20}/$range.pbf"
  done
done
```
